local function authorDescendants(map: Model): { Instance }

			signatures,

				\046\046 tostring(part\046CFrame)
				\046\046 "/"
				\046\046 tostring(part\046Size)
				\046\046 "/"
				\046\046 padding
		)

	for _, folderName in { "NoCornZones", "Props" } do
		local folder = map:FindFirstChild(folderName)

				if item:IsA("BasePart") then

			end
		end
	end

			if item:HasTag("corn_key_slot") then
				table\046insert(circles, { Center = item\046Position, Radius = SLOT_RADIUS })
				table\046insert(signatures, item:GetFullName() \046\046 "/slot/" \046\046 tostring(item\046Position))

			end
		end

	for _, circle in exclusions\046Circles do
		local delta = position - circle\046Center
		if delta\046X * delta\046X + delta\046Z * delta\046Z <= circle\046Radius * circle\046Radius then
			return true
		end
	end
	for _, box in exclusions\046Boxes do
		local localPosition = box\046Frame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
		if
			math\046abs(localPosition\046X) <= box\046HalfSize\046X
			and math\046abs(localPosition\046Z) <= box\046HalfSize\046Y
		then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local MinimapGeometry = {
	CompactSize = 180,
	UpdateHz = 10,
	VisitPadding = 3,
	VisitHeight = 12,
	ClearingRadius = 6,
}

export type Visit = { id: string, kind: string, position: Vector3 }
export type Death = { id: number, kind: string, position: Vector3 }
export type History = { round_id: number, visited: { Visit }, deaths: { Death } }

local function finite(value: any): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math\046huge and value < math\046huge
end

local function position(value: any): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "Vector3" and finite(value\046X) and finite(value\046Y) and finite(value\046Z)
end

function MinimapGeometry\046IsValid(value: any): boolean
	if
		typeof(value) ~= "table"
		or not finite(value\046round_id)
		or value\046round_id < 0
		or value\046round_id % 1 ~= 0
	then
		return false
	end
	if
		typeof(value\046visited) ~= "table"
		or typeof(value\046deaths) ~= "table"
		or #value\046visited > 18
		or #value\046deaths > 3
	then
		return false
	end
	local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local count = 0
	for index, visit in value\046visited do
		count += 1
		if
			typeof(index) ~= "number"
			or index % 1 ~= 0
			or index < 1
			or index > #value\046visited
			or typeof(visit) ~= "table"
			or typeof(visit\046id) ~= "string"
			or visit\046id == ""
			or #visit\046id > 100
			or seen[visit\046id]
			or (visit\046kind ~= "clearing" and visit\046kind ~= "house")
			or not position(visit\046position)
		then
			return false
		end
		seen[visit\046id] = true
	end
	if count ~= #value\046visited then
		return false
	end
	local deaths: { [number]: boolean } = {}
	count = 0
	for index, death in value\046deaths do
		count += 1
		if
			typeof(index) ~= "number"
			or index % 1 ~= 0
			or index < 1
			or index > #value\046deaths
			or typeof(death) ~= "table"
			or not finite(death\046id)
			or death\046id < 1
			or death\046id % 1 ~= 0
			or deaths[death\046id]
			or (death\046kind ~= "caught" and death\046kind ~= "death")
			or not position(death\046position)
		then
			return false
		end
		deaths[death\046id] = true
	end
	return count == #value\046deaths
end

function MinimapGeometry\046Project(frame: CFrame, size: Vector3, worldPosition: Vector3): Vector2
	local point = frame:PointToObjectSpace(worldPosition)
	return Vector2\046new(
		math\046clamp(point\046X / size\046X + 0\0465, 0, 1),
		math\046clamp(point\046Z / size\046Z + 0\0465, 0, 1)
	)
end

function MinimapGeometry\046Heading(frame: CFrame, direction: Vector3): number
	local localDirection = frame:VectorToObjectSpace(direction)
	return math\046deg(math\046atan2(localDirection\046X, -localDirection\046Z))
end

return MinimapGeometry

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

AuthoredWorld\046__index = AuthoredWorld

local function namedPart(parent: Instance, name: string): BasePart
	local item = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	assert(item and item:IsA("BasePart"), "Missing map part: " \046\046 name)
	return item
end

local function hasTag(item: Instance, tag: string): boolean
	return CollectionService:HasTag(item, tag)
end

local function prompt(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	action: string,
	object: string,
	radius: number
): ProximityPrompt
	assert(not parent:FindFirstChild(name), "Duplicate owned prompt: " \046\046 name)
	local item = Instance\046new("ProximityPrompt")
	item\046Name = name
	item\046ActionText = action
	item\046ObjectText = object
	item\046KeyboardKeyCode = Enum\046KeyCode\046E
	item\046MaxActivationDistance = radius
	item\046RequiresLineOfSight = true
	item\046HoldDuration = 0
	item\046Enabled = false
	item\046Parent = parent
	return item
end

local function inBox(part: BasePart, position: Vector3): boolean
	local point = part\046CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
	local half = part\046Size / 2
	return math\046abs(point\046X) <= half\046X
		and math\046abs(point\046Y) <= half\046Y
		and math\046abs(point\046Z) <= half\046Z
end

local function validateSpawn(root: Model, spawn: BasePart, bounds: BasePart)
	assert(spawn:IsDescendantOf(root), "Spawn must belong to CornMap")
	assert(hasTag(spawn, "corn_spawn"), "Missing corn_spawn tag: " \046\046 spawn\046Name)
	local id = spawn:GetAttribute("spawn_id")
	assert(type(id) == "string" and id ~= "", "Spawn id must be a nonempty string: " \046\046 spawn\046Name)
	assert(spawn\046Anchored, "Spawn must be Anchored: " \046\046 spawn\046Name)
	assert(
		spawn\046CFrame\046UpVector:Dot(Vector3\046yAxis) > 0\046999,
		"Spawn must remain horizontal: " \046\046 spawn\046Name
	)
	if spawn:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
		assert(
			spawn\046Enabled and spawn\046Neutral,
			"Corner spawn must be enabled and neutral: " \046\046 spawn\046Name
		)
	end
	local position = (spawn\046CFrame * CFrame\046new(0, spawn\046Size\046Y / 2 + 3\0465, 0))\046Position
	assert(inBox(bounds, position), "Spawn is outside PlayBounds: " \046\046 spawn\046Name)
end

function AuthoredWorld\046IsSafeSpawn(root: Model, spawn: BasePart): boolean
	local bounds = root:FindFirstChild("PlayBounds")
	return bounds ~= nil and bounds:IsA("BasePart") and pcall(validateSpawn, root, spawn, bounds)
end

function AuthoredWorld\046ReadSpawns(root: Model): { BasePart }
	local bounds = namedPart(root, "PlayBounds")
	local corners = root:FindFirstChild("CornerSpawns")
	local spawns: { BasePart } = {}
	if corners then
		assert(
			corners:IsA("Folder")
				and corners:GetAttribute("CornCornerSpawnsOwned") == true
				and corners:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
			"Unrecognized CornerSpawns"
		)
		local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
		for _, item in corners:GetChildren() do
			assert(item:IsA("SpawnLocation"), "CornerSpawns must contain only SpawnLocations")
			validateSpawn(root, item, bounds)
			local id = item:GetAttribute("spawn_id") :: string
			assert(not seen[id], "Corner spawn ids must be unique")
			seen[id] = true
			table\046insert(spawns, item)
		end
		assert(#spawns == 4, "CornMap must have four corner spawns")
		table\046sort(spawns, function(a, b)
			return tostring(a:GetAttribute("spawn_id")) < tostring(b:GetAttribute("spawn_id"))
		end)
	else
		local legacy = namedPart(root, "RoundSpawn")
		validateSpawn(root, legacy, bounds)
		table\046insert(spawns, legacy)
	end
	return spawns
end

function AuthoredWorld\046FindSafeSpawn(root: Model): BasePart?
	local bounds = root:FindFirstChild("PlayBounds")
	if not bounds or not bounds:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil
	end
	local candidates: { BasePart } = {}
	local corners = root:FindFirstChild("CornerSpawns")
	if
		corners
		and corners:IsA("Folder")
		and corners:GetAttribute("CornCornerSpawnsOwned") == true
		and corners:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
	then
		for _, item in corners:GetChildren() do
			if item:IsA("SpawnLocation") and pcall(validateSpawn, root, item, bounds) then
				table\046insert(candidates, item)
			end
		end
	end
	table\046sort(candidates, function(a, b)
		return tostring(a:GetAttribute("spawn_id")) < tostring(b:GetAttribute("spawn_id"))
	end)
	if candidates[1] then
		return candidates[1]
	end
	local legacy = root:FindFirstChild("RoundSpawn")
	if legacy and legacy:IsA("BasePart") and pcall(validateSpawn, root, legacy, bounds) then
		return legacy
	end
	return nil
end

	return spawn\046CFrame * CFrame\046new(0, spawn\046Size\046Y / 2 + 3\0465, 0)
end

function AuthoredWorld\046new(radius: number, expectedSlots: number)
	local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	assert(
		root and root:IsA("Model") and root:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
		"Install the editable CornMap in Children_of_corn before Test"
	)
	local spawns = AuthoredWorld\046ReadSpawns(root)
	local field = namedPart(root, "FieldZone")
	local ground = namedPart(root, "Ground")
	local home = root\046Props:FindFirstChild("ScarecrowMarker")
	assert(home and home:IsA("Model") and home:HasTag("corn_monster_home"), "Monster home missing")
	local bounds = namedPart(root, "PlayBounds")
	local gateModel = root:FindFirstChild("EscapeGate")
	assert(

		"Missing tagged EscapeGate"

	local gate = namedPart(gateModel, "Door")
	local anchor = namedPart(gateModel, "InteractionAnchor")
	local exit = namedPart(gateModel, "ExitZone")
	assert(hasTag(exit, "corn_exit"), "Missing corn_exit tag")
	local gateId = gateModel:GetAttribute("gate_id")
	assert(type(gateId) == "string" and gateId ~= "", "Gate id must be a nonempty string")
	assert(exit:GetAttribute("gate_id") == gateId, "Gate/exit identity mismatch")
	local slots: { BasePart } = {}
	local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, item in root:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") and hasTag(item, "corn_key_slot") then
			local id = item:GetAttribute("slot_id")
			assert(
				type(id) == "string" and id ~= "" and not seen[id],
				"Key slot ids must be unique strings"
			)
			seen[id] = true
			table\046insert(slots, item)

	end
	assert(#slots == expectedSlots, "CornMap must have " \046\046 tostring(expectedSlots) \046\046 " key slots")
	table\046sort(slots, function(a, b)
		return tostring(a:GetAttribute("slot_id")) < tostring(b:GetAttribute("slot_id"))
	end)
	assert(not root:FindFirstChild("CornRoundRuntime"), "CornRoundRuntime already exists")
	assert(not anchor:FindFirstChild("CornGatePrompt"), "CornGatePrompt already exists")
	assert(gate\046CanCollide, "Closed Door must have CanCollide enabled")
	local artOk, artReady = pcall(CornField\046Prepare)
	if not artOk or not artReady then
		warn("[AuthoredWorld] Corn art unavailable:", artReady)
	end
	local runtime = Instance\046new("Folder")
	runtime\046Name = "CornRoundRuntime"
	runtime:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	runtime\046Parent = root
	local gatePrompt = prompt(anchor, "CornGatePrompt", "Открыть", "Ворота", radius)
	local self = setmetatable({
		Root = root,
		Radius = radius,
		Slots = slots,
		Spawns = spawns,
		Spawn = spawns[1],
		Field = field,
		Ground = ground,
		Home = home,
		Bounds = bounds,

		ClosedCollision = gate\046CanCollide,
		ClosedQuery = gate\046CanQuery,
		Key = nil :: Part?,

	assert(index % 1 == 0 and index >= 1 and index <= #self\046Spawns, "Invalid spawn index")

	key\046CanTouch = false

		prompt(key, "CornKeyPrompt", "Подобрать", "Ключ от ворот", self\046Radius)

	local ray = RaycastParams\046new()
	ray\046FilterType = Enum\046RaycastFilterType\046Exclude

	ray\046RespectCanCollide = true
	local overlap = OverlapParams\046new()
	overlap\046FilterType = Enum\046RaycastFilterType\046Include
	overlap\046FilterDescendantsInstances = { self\046Root\046Props, self\046Root\046Boundaries, self\046Gate }
	overlap\046RespectCanCollide = true
	for ring = 0, radius do
		for angle = 0, if ring == 0 then 0 else 7 do
			local offset = Vector3\046new(
				math\046cos(angle * math\046pi / 4),
				0,
				math\046sin(angle * math\046pi / 4)

			local at = position + offset
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(at + Vector3\046new(0, 10, 0), Vector3\046new(0, -40, 0), ray)
			if

					CFrame\046new(place + Vector3\046new(0, 1, 0)),
					Vector3\046new(3, 2, 3),
					overlap

	if
		self\046Root\046Parent ~= Workspace
		or not self\046Runtime:IsDescendantOf(self\046Root)
		or not self\046Spawn:IsDescendantOf(self\046Root)
		or not self\046Field:IsDescendantOf(self\046Root)
		or not self\046Bounds:IsDescendantOf(self\046Root)
		or not self\046Gate:IsDescendantOf(self\046Root)
		or not self\046GateAnchor:IsDescendantOf(self\046Root)
		or not self\046Exit:IsDescendantOf(self\046Root)
		or not self\046GatePrompt:IsDescendantOf(self\046GateAnchor)
		or #self\046Slots ~= 15

	for _, spawn in self\046Spawns do
		if not pcall(validateSpawn, self\046Root, spawn, self\046Bounds) then
			return false

		if spawnIds[id] then

	if type(gateId) ~= "string" or gateId == "" or gateId ~= self\046Exit:GetAttribute("gate_id") then
		return false

		if not slot:IsDescendantOf(self\046Root) then

function MapAuthoring\046EnsureCornerSpawns(map: Model): Folder
	guard()
	assert(
		map\046Parent == Workspace and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
		"Corner spawns require the correct editable CornMap"
	)
	local field = map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone")
	local bounds = map:FindFirstChild("PlayBounds")
	assert(
		field and field:IsA("BasePart") and bounds and bounds:IsA("BasePart"),
		"FieldZone/PlayBounds missing"
	)
	assert(field\046CFrame\046UpVector:Dot(Vector3\046yAxis) > 0\046999, "FieldZone must remain horizontal")
	assert(field\046Size\046X > 100 and field\046Size\046Z > 100, "FieldZone is too small for corner starts")
	local entries = {
		{ Name = "SW", Id = "solo_corner_sw", X = -1, Z = -1 },
		{ Name = "SE", Id = "solo_corner_se", X = 1, Z = -1 },
		{ Name = "NW", Id = "solo_corner_nw", X = -1, Z = 1 },
		{ Name = "NE", Id = "solo_corner_ne", X = 1, Z = 1 },
	}
	local old = map:FindFirstChild("CornerSpawns")
	if old then
		assert(
			old:IsA("Folder")
				and old:GetAttribute("CornCornerSpawnsOwned") == true
				and old:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
			"Unrecognized CornerSpawns; not replaced"
		)
		assert(#old:GetChildren() == 4, "CornerSpawns must contain exactly four owned starts")
		for _, entry in entries do
			local item = old:FindFirstChild(entry\046Name)
			assert(
				item
					and item:IsA("SpawnLocation")
					and item:GetAttribute("spawn_id") == entry\046Id
					and item:GetAttribute("CornCornerSpawnOwned") == true
					and item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
					and CollectionService:HasTag(item, "corn_spawn")
					and item\046Enabled
					and item\046Neutral,
				"Unknown or invalid corner start: " \046\046 entry\046Name
			)
			local position = bounds\046CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(
				(item\046CFrame * CFrame\046new(0, item\046Size\046Y / 2 + 3\0465, 0))\046Position
			)
			local half = bounds\046Size / 2
			assert(
				math\046abs(position\046X) <= half\046X
					and math\046abs(position\046Y) <= half\046Y
					and math\046abs(position\046Z) <= half\046Z
					and item\046Anchored
					and item\046CFrame\046UpVector:Dot(Vector3\046yAxis) > 0\046999,
				"Corner start is unsafe: " \046\046 entry\046Name
			)
		end
		return old
	end
	local folder = Instance\046new("Folder")
	folder\046Name = "CornerSpawns"
	folder:SetAttribute("CornCornerSpawnsOwned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	local ok, problem = pcall(function()
		for _, entry in entries do
			local localPosition = Vector3\046new(
				entry\046X * (field\046Size\046X / 2 - 50),
				-field\046Size\046Y / 2 + 0\046075,
				entry\046Z * (field\046Size\046Z / 2 - 50)
			)
			local position = field\046CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(localPosition)
			local center = Vector3\046new(field\046Position\046X, position\046Y, field\046Position\046Z)
			local item = Instance\046new("SpawnLocation")
			item\046Parent = folder
			item\046Name = entry\046Name
			item\046Size = Vector3\046new(6, 0\04615, 6)
			item\046CFrame = CFrame\046lookAt(position, center)
			item\046Anchored = true
			item\046CanCollide = false
			item\046CanTouch = false
			item\046CanQuery = false
			item\046Neutral = true
			item\046Enabled = true
			item\046AllowTeamChangeOnTouch = false
			item\046Duration = 0
			item\046Color = Color3\046fromRGB(158, 176, 150)
			item:SetAttribute("spawn_id", entry\046Id)
			item:SetAttribute("CornCornerSpawnOwned", true)
			item:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
			CollectionService:AddTag(item, "corn_spawn")
			local candidate = bounds\046CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(
				(item\046CFrame * CFrame\046new(0, item\046Size\046Y / 2 + 3\0465, 0))\046Position
			)
			local half = bounds\046Size / 2
			assert(
				math\046abs(candidate\046X) <= half\046X
					and math\046abs(candidate\046Y) <= half\046Y
					and math\046abs(candidate\046Z) <= half\046Z,
				"Corner start is outside PlayBounds"
			)
			item\046Parent = folder
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		folder:Destroy()
		error(tostring(problem))
	end
	folder\046Parent = map
	return folder

function MapAuthoring\046Preview(map: Model, center: Vector3, radius: number?): number
	guard()
	local field = map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone")
	assert(field and field:IsA("BasePart"), "CornMap FieldZone missing")
	local old = map:FindFirstChild("EditorPreview")
	assert(
		not old
			or (
				old:IsA("Folder")
				and old:GetAttribute("CornEditorPreview") == true
				and old:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
			),
		"Unrecognized EditorPreview; not replaced"
	)
	local prepared, problem = Layout\046PrepareTemplate(artSource())
	assert(prepared, problem or "Cannot prepare corn preview")
	local folder = Instance\046new("Folder")
	folder\046Name = "EditorPreview"
	folder:SetAttribute("CornEditorPreview", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	local distance = math\046clamp(radius or 55, 10, 85)
	local localCenter = field\046CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(center)
	local minColumn, maxColumn, minRow, maxRow = Layout\046GetCellBounds(field)
	minColumn = math\046max(minColumn, math\046ceil((localCenter\046X - distance) / Layout\046Spacing))
	maxColumn = math\046min(maxColumn, math\046floor((localCenter\046X + distance) / Layout\046Spacing))
	minRow = math\046max(minRow, math\046ceil((localCenter\046Z - distance) / Layout\046Spacing))
	maxRow = math\046min(maxRow, math\046floor((localCenter\046Z + distance) / Layout\046Spacing))
	local exclusions = Layout\046ReadExclusions(map, field)
	local _, fieldYaw = field\046CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local count = 0
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		for row = minRow, maxRow do
			for column = minColumn, maxColumn do
				local position = Layout\046CellPosition(field, column, row)
				local delta = position - center
				if
					Vector2\046new(delta\046X, delta\046Z)\046Magnitude <= distance
					and not Layout\046IsExcluded(position, exclusions)
				then
					local clone = prepared:Clone()
					assert(clone, "Corn clone is not Archivable")
					clone\046Name = "Corn"
					Layout\046ApplyVariation(clone, column, row)
					clone:PivotTo(
						Layout\046PivotForPlant(
							clone,
							position,
							Layout\046CellYaw(column, row) + fieldYaw
						)
					)
					clone\046Parent = folder
					count += 1
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	prepared:Destroy()
	if not ok then
		folder:Destroy()
		error(tostring(err))
	end
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	folder\046Parent = map
	folder:SetAttribute("PlantCount", count)
	map:SetAttribute("EditorCornCount", count)
	return count
end

function MapAuthoring\046RebuildOverview(map: Model): number
	guard()
	assert(
		map\046Parent == Workspace and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
		"CornMap missing"
	)
	local field = map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone")
	assert(field and field:IsA("BasePart"), "FieldZone missing")
	assert(field\046CFrame\046UpVector:Dot(Vector3\046yAxis) > 0\0469999, "FieldZone must stay horizontal")
	local old = map:FindFirstChild("EditorFieldOverview")
	if old then
		assert(
			old:IsA("Folder")
				and old:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
				and old:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
			"Unrecognized overview; retained"
		)
		for _, item in old:GetChildren() do
			assert(
				item:IsA("BasePart")
					and item:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
					and item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
				"Overview contains manual objects; retained"
			)
		end
	end
	local prepared, problem = Layout\046PrepareTemplate(artSource())
	assert(prepared, problem or "Cannot prepare overview art")
	assert(prepared:IsA("MeshPart"), "Whole-field overview requires the imported single-mesh corn")
	local stride = 12
	-- Preserve plant proportions\046 This sparse layer is an approximate field overview,
	-- while EditorPreview and the client renderer provide dense, life-size plants\046
	local _, preparedSize = Layout\046Bounds(prepared)
	local half = preparedSize / 2
	local folder = Instance\046new("Folder")
	folder\046Name = "EditorFieldOverview"
	folder:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	folder:SetAttribute("OverviewSpacing", stride)
	folder:SetAttribute("OverviewApproximation", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("OverviewPlantScale", 1)
	local exclusions = Layout\046ReadExclusions(map, field)
	local _, yaw = field\046CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local count = 0
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		for row = math\046ceil(-field\046Size\046Z / 2 / stride), math\046floor(field\046Size\046Z / 2 / stride) do
			for column = math\046ceil(-field\046Size\046X / 2 / stride), math\046floor(field\046Size\046X / 2 / stride) do
				local ground = field\046CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
					Vector3\046new(column * stride, -field\046Size\046Y / 2, row * stride)
				)
				local excluded = false
				for _, x in { -1, 0, 1 } do
					for _, z in { -1, 0, 1 } do
						local sample = ground
							+ field\046CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(
								Vector3\046new(x * half\046X, 0, z * half\046Z)
							)
						if Layout\046IsExcluded(sample, exclusions) then
							excluded = true
							break
						end
					end
					if excluded then
						break
					end
				end
				if excluded then
					continue
				end
				local clone = prepared:Clone()
				assert(clone, "Overview clone failed")
				clone\046Name = "DistantCorn"
				clone:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
				clone:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
				local cellColumn = math\046round(column * stride / Layout\046Spacing)
				local cellRow = math\046round(row * stride / Layout\046Spacing)
				Layout\046ApplyVariation(clone, cellColumn, cellRow)
				clone:PivotTo(
					Layout\046PivotForPlant(clone, ground, yaw + Layout\046CellYaw(cellColumn, cellRow))
				)
				clone\046Parent = folder
				count += 1
				if count % 128 == 0 then
					task\046wait()
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	prepared:Destroy()
	if not ok then
		folder:Destroy()
		error(tostring(err))
	end
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	folder:SetAttribute("PlantCount", count)
	folder\046Parent = map
	print(
		"CornMap whole-field overview:",
		count,
		"upright sparse overview meshes; fine corn uses 3-stud spacing"
	)
	return count
end

function MapAuthoring\046Preview(map: Model, center: Vector3, radius: number?): number
	guard()
	local field = map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone")
	assert(field and field:IsA("BasePart"), "CornMap FieldZone missing")
	local old = map:FindFirstChild("EditorPreview")
	assert(
		not old
			or (
				old:IsA("Folder")
				and old:GetAttribute("CornEditorPreview") == true
				and old:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
			),
		"Unrecognized EditorPreview; not replaced"
	)
	local prepared, problem = Layout\046PrepareTemplate(artSource())
	assert(prepared, problem or "Cannot prepare corn preview")
	local folder = Instance\046new("Folder")
	folder\046Name = "EditorPreview"
	folder:SetAttribute("CornEditorPreview", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	local distance = math\046clamp(radius or 55, 10, 85)
	local localCenter = field\046CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(center)
	local minColumn, maxColumn, minRow, maxRow = Layout\046GetCellBounds(field)
	minColumn = math\046max(minColumn, math\046ceil((localCenter\046X - distance) / Layout\046Spacing))
	maxColumn = math\046min(maxColumn, math\046floor((localCenter\046X + distance) / Layout\046Spacing))
	minRow = math\046max(minRow, math\046ceil((localCenter\046Z - distance) / Layout\046Spacing))
	maxRow = math\046min(maxRow, math\046floor((localCenter\046Z + distance) / Layout\046Spacing))
	local exclusions = Layout\046ReadExclusions(map, field)
	local _, fieldYaw = field\046CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local count = 0
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		for row = minRow, maxRow do
			for column = minColumn, maxColumn do
				local position = Layout\046CellPosition(field, column, row)
				local delta = position - center
				if
					Vector2\046new(delta\046X, delta\046Z)\046Magnitude <= distance
					and not Layout\046IsExcluded(position, exclusions)
				then
					local clone = prepared:Clone()
					assert(clone, "Corn clone is not Archivable")
					clone\046Name = "Corn"
					Layout\046ApplyVariation(clone, column, row)
					clone:PivotTo(

							position,
							Layout\046CellYaw(column, row) + fieldYaw

					clone\046Parent = folder

			end
		end
	end)
	prepared:Destroy()
	if not ok then
		folder:Destroy()
		error(tostring(err))
	end
	if old then
		old:Destroy()

	folder\046Parent = map

function MapAuthoring\046RebuildOverview(map: Model): number

	assert(
		map\046Parent == Workspace and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
		"CornMap missing"

			"Unrecognized overview; retained"
		)
		for _, item in old:GetChildren() do
			assert(

					and item:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true

	assert(prepared:IsA("MeshPart"), "Whole-field overview requires the imported single-mesh corn")

	local folder = Instance\046new("Folder")
	folder\046Name = "EditorFieldOverview"

		for row = math\046ceil(-field\046Size\046Z / 2 / stride), math\046floor(field\046Size\046Z / 2 / stride) do
			for column = math\046ceil(-field\046Size\046X / 2 / stride), math\046floor(field\046Size\046X / 2 / stride) do

								Vector3\046new(x * half\046X, 0, z * half\046Z)

				clone\046Name = "DistantCorn"

end

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Geometry = require(
	ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
		:WaitForChild("Game")
		:WaitForChild("MinimapGeometry")
)

local BOUNDARY_EPSILON = 0\0460001
local MAX_VISITS = 18
local MAX_DEATHS = 3
local HOUSE_NAMES = { "HouseWest", "HouseEast", "HouseNorthWest" }

local MinimapState = { PollInterval = 1 / Geometry\046UpdateHz }
MinimapState\046__index = MinimapState

local function finitePosition(position: Vector3): boolean
	return position\046X == position\046X
		and position\046Y == position\046Y
		and position\046Z == position\046Z
		and math\046abs(position\046X) < math\046huge
		and math\046abs(position\046Y) < math\046huge
		and math\046abs(position\046Z) < math\046huge
end

function MinimapState\046new()
	return setmetatable({
		roundId = 0,
		visited = {} :: { any },
		visitedIds = {} :: { [string]: boolean },
		deaths = {} :: { any },
		deadCharacters = {} :: { [Model]: boolean },
	}, MinimapState)
end

function MinimapState:ClearHistory()
	table\046clear(self\046visited)
	table\046clear(self\046visitedIds)
	table\046clear(self\046deaths)
	table\046clear(self\046deadCharacters)
end

function MinimapState:ResetHistory()
	self\046roundId += 1
	self:ClearHistory()
end

function MinimapState:_visit(id: string, kind: string, position: Vector3): boolean
	if self\046visitedIds[id] or #self\046visited >= MAX_VISITS or not finitePosition(position) then
		return false
	end
	self\046visitedIds[id] = true
	table\046insert(self\046visited, { id = id, kind = kind, position = position })
	return true
end

function MinimapState:Poll(world: any, position: Vector3): boolean
	if not finitePosition(position) then
		return false
	end
	local changed = false
	local field = world\046Field
	if math\046abs(position\046Y - field\046Position\046Y) <= Geometry\046VisitHeight then
		local radius = Geometry\046ClearingRadius + Geometry\046VisitPadding + BOUNDARY_EPSILON
		for _, slot in world\046Slots do
			if slot:IsDescendantOf(world\046Root) and slot:HasTag("corn_key_slot") then
				local slotId = slot:GetAttribute("slot_id")
				local offset = position - slot\046Position
				if
					type(slotId) == "string"
					and slotId ~= ""
					and offset\046X * offset\046X + offset\046Z * offset\046Z <= radius * radius
				then
					changed = self:_visit("clearing:" \046\046 slotId, "clearing", slot\046Position)
						or changed
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local props = world\046Root:FindFirstChild("Props")
	if props then
		for _, name in HOUSE_NAMES do
			local house = props:FindFirstChild(name)
			if house and house:IsA("Model") and house:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
				local frame, size = house:GetBoundingBox()
				-- Horizontal bounds follow the authored house yaw; height is a separate tolerance\046
				local projected = Vector3\046new(position\046X, frame\046Position\046Y, position\046Z)
				local localPosition = frame:PointToObjectSpace(projected)
				if
					math\046abs(position\046Y - frame\046Position\046Y) <= Geometry\046VisitHeight
					and math\046abs(localPosition\046X) <= size\046X / 2 + Geometry\046VisitPadding + BOUNDARY_EPSILON
					and math\046abs(localPosition\046Z)
						<= size\046Z / 2 + Geometry\046VisitPadding + BOUNDARY_EPSILON
				then
					changed = self:_visit("house:" \046\046 name, "house", frame\046Position) or changed
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return changed
end

function MinimapState:RecordCaught(position: Vector3): boolean
	if #self\046deaths >= MAX_DEATHS or not finitePosition(position) then
		return false
	end
	table\046insert(self\046deaths, { id = #self\046deaths + 1, kind = "caught", position = position })
	return true
end

function MinimapState:RecordDeath(character: Model, position: Vector3): boolean
	if
		self\046deadCharacters[character]
		or #self\046deaths >= MAX_DEATHS
		or not finitePosition(position)
	then
		return false
	end
	self\046deadCharacters[character] = true
	table\046insert(self\046deaths, { id = #self\046deaths + 1, kind = "death", position = position })
	return true

	for _, item in self\046visited do
		table\046insert(visited, { id = item\046id, kind = item\046kind, position = item\046position })
	end
	for _, item in self\046deaths do
		table\046insert(deaths, { id = item\046id, kind = item\046kind, position = item\046position })

function SoloRound:_controls(enabled: boolean)
	if not enabled then
		Stamina\046Request(self\046stamina, false, os\046clock(), false)
	end
	local character, humanoid = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not character or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	if self\046controlledCharacter ~= character then
		self\046controlledCharacter = character
		self\046jumpPower = humanoid\046JumpPower
		self\046jumpHeight = humanoid\046JumpHeight
		self\046autoRotate = humanoid\046AutoRotate
	end
	humanoid\046WalkSpeed = if enabled then self\046balance\046walk_speed else 0
	humanoid\046JumpPower = if enabled then self\046jumpPower else 0
	humanoid\046JumpHeight = if enabled then self\046jumpHeight else 0
	humanoid\046AutoRotate = enabled and self\046autoRotate
end

function SoloRound:_fallbackSpawn(): BasePart?
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
	then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(AuthoredWorld\046FindSafeSpawn, map)
	if not ok then
		self\046context\046Log:Warn("Cannot find a safe CornMap spawn:", result)
		return nil
	end
	return result
end

function SoloRound:_setRespawnLocation()
	local player = self\046player
	if not player then
		return
	end
	local spawn = self\046selectedSpawn
	player\046RespawnLocation = if spawn
			and spawn:IsA("SpawnLocation")
			and spawn:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)
		then spawn
		else nil
end

function SoloRound:_chooseSpawn()
	if self\046world and self\046world:IsValid() then
		self\046selectedSpawn = self\046world:SelectSpawn(self\046random:NextInteger(1, #self\046world\046Spawns))
	else
		self\046selectedSpawn = self:_fallbackSpawn()
	end
	self:_setRespawnLocation()
end

function SoloRound:_moveToStart(character: Model)
	local spawn = self\046selectedSpawn
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not spawn
		or not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or not AuthoredWorld\046IsSafeSpawn(map, spawn)
	then
		spawn = self:_fallbackSpawn()
		self\046selectedSpawn = spawn
	end
	if not spawn then
		self\046context\046Log:Warn("No valid CornMap start; install or repair CornerSpawns")
		return
	end
	self:_setRespawnLocation()
	character:PivotTo(AuthoredWorld\046SpawnCFrame(spawn))
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		root\046AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3\046zero
		root\046AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3\046zero
	end
end

function SoloRound:_clearKey()
	if self\046keyConnection then
		self\046keyConnection:Disconnect()
		self\046keyConnection = nil
	end
	if self\046world then
		self\046world:ClearKey()
	end
end

function SoloRound:_finish(phase: string, notice: string)
	if self\046phase ~= "active" and self\046phase ~= "preparing" and self\046phase ~= "caught" then
		return
	end
	-- Fix the terminal state before rewarding or notifying any client\046
	self\046elapsed = if self\046startedAt then os\046clock() - self\046startedAt else 0
	self\046phase = phase
	self\046epoch += 1
	self\046notice = notice
	self\046reward = if phase == "escaped" then self\046balance\046escape_reward_diamonds else 0
	self\046diamonds += self\046reward
	self\046hasKey = false
	self:_clearKey()
	if self\046world then
		self\046world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, self\046gateOpen)
	end
	self:_stopHunt()
	self:_controls(false)
	self:_send()
	self\046context\046Log:Info("Round finished:", phase, "reward:", self\046reward)

function SoloRound:_canInteract(
	player: Player,
	item: BasePart,
	itemPrompt: ProximityPrompt
): boolean
	if player ~= self\046player or self\046phase ~= "active" or not itemPrompt\046Enabled then
		return false
	end
	local now = os\046clock()
	if now - self\046interactionAt < 0\04625 then
		return false
	end
	self\046interactionAt = now
	local character, _, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not character or character ~= self\046roundCharacter or not root then
		return false
	end
	if not self\046world or not item:IsDescendantOf(self\046world\046Root) then
		return false
	end
	local direction = item\046Position - root\046Position
	if direction\046Magnitude > self\046balance\046interaction_radius then
		return false
	end
	local params = RaycastParams\046new()
	params\046FilterType = Enum\046RaycastFilterType\046Exclude
	params\046FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params\046RespectCanCollide = true
	local hit = Workspace:Raycast(root\046Position, direction, params)
	return not hit or hit\046Instance == item
end

function SoloRound:_openGate(player: Player)
	local world = self\046world
	if
		not world
		or self\046gateOpen
		or not self:_canInteract(player, world\046GateAnchor, world\046GatePrompt)
	then
		return
	end
	local _, _, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not root or not world:IsGateFront(root\046Position) then
		return
	end
	if not self\046hasKey then
		self\046notice = "corn_loop_need_key"
		self:_send()
		return
	end
	self\046hasKey = false
	self\046gateOpen = true
	self\046notice = ""
	world:SetGateOpen(true)
	self:_send()
end

function SoloRound:_ensureWorld(): boolean
	if self\046world then
		return self\046world:IsValid()
	end
	local ok, result =
		pcall(AuthoredWorld\046new, self\046balance\046interaction_radius, self\046balance\046key_slot_count)
	if not ok then
		self\046context\046Log:Warn("Cannot bind editable CornMap:", result)
		return false
	end
	self\046world = result
	if self\046selectedSpawn and table\046find(self\046world\046Spawns, self\046selectedSpawn) then
		self\046world\046Spawn = self\046selectedSpawn
	end
	table\046insert(
		self\046connections,
		self\046world\046GatePrompt\046Triggered:Connect(function(player: Player)
			self:_openGate(player)
		end)
	)
	return true
end

function SoloRound:_stopHunt()
	if self\046hunt then
		self\046hunt:Destroy()
		self\046hunt = nil
	end
end

function SoloRound:_bindKey(keyPrompt: ProximityPrompt)
	if self\046keyConnection then
		self\046keyConnection:Disconnect()
	end
	local epoch = self\046epoch
	self\046keyConnection = keyPrompt\046Triggered:Connect(function(player: Player)
		local key = self\046world\046Key
		if
			self\046epoch ~= epoch
			or self\046hasKey
			or self\046gateOpen
			or not key
			or keyPrompt ~= self\046world\046KeyPrompt
		then
			return
		end
		if not self:_canInteract(player, key, keyPrompt) then
			return
		end
		self\046hasKey = true
		self\046notice = ""
		self:_clearKey()
		self:_send()
	end)
end

function SoloRound:_caught(root: BasePart)
	if self\046phase ~= "active" then
		return
	end
	self\046catches += 1
	if self\046catches >= self\046balance\046max_catches then
		self:_finish("caught_out", "corn_hunt_defeat_notice")
		return
	end
	self\046elapsed = if self\046startedAt then os\046clock() - self\046startedAt else 0
	self\046phase = "caught"
	self\046notice = if self\046hasKey then "corn_hunt_key_dropped" else "corn_hunt_first_catch"
	local epoch = self\046epoch
	if self\046hasKey then
		self\046hasKey = false
		local prompt = self\046world:DropKey(root\046Position, self\046balance\046key_drop_adjust_radius)
		if not prompt then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_hunt_drop_error")
			return

	self:_controls(false)
	self:_send()
	task\046delay(self\046balance\046capture_transition_sec, function()
		if self\046epoch ~= epoch or self\046phase ~= "caught" then
			return

		if not character or character ~= self\046roundCharacter then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")

		self\046protectedUntil = os\046clock() + self\046balance\046respawn_protection_sec
		self\046hunt:ResetHome()
		self\046huntAt = os\046clock()
		self\046phase = "active"
		self\046world:SetInteractionEnabled(true, self\046gateOpen)
		self:_controls(true)
		self:_send()
	end)
end

function SoloRound:_restoreLighting()
	if self\046lightingState then
		LightingModes\046Restore(Lighting, self\046lightingState)
		self\046lightingState = nil
	end
end

function SoloRound:_startRound(mode: string)

		and self\046phase ~= "escaped"
		and self\046phase ~= "aborted"
		and self\046phase ~= "caught_out"

	self\046catches = 0
	self\046protectedUntil = 0
	local epoch = self\046epoch
	self\046phase = "preparing"
	self\046startedAt = nil
	self\046elapsed = 0
	self\046reward = 0
	self\046notice = ""
	self\046hasKey = false
	self\046gateOpen = false

			and self\046phase == "preparing"
			and self\046player
			and self\046player\046Parent == Players

			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
			return
		end

			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
			return

		self\046huntAt = self\046startedAt
		self\046phase = "active"
		self\046world:SetInteractionEnabled(true, false)
		self:_controls(true)
		self:_send()
		self\046context\046Log:Info("Solo round started")
	end)
end

function SoloRound:_menu()
	if self\046phase ~= "escaped" and self\046phase ~= "aborted" and self\046phase ~= "caught_out" then
		return
	end
	self\046epoch += 1
	self\046phase = "ready"
	self:_restoreLighting()
	self\046reward = 0
	self\046elapsed = 0
	self\046startedAt = nil
	self\046notice = ""
	self\046hasKey = false
	self\046gateOpen = false
	self:_clearKey()
	if self\046world then
		self\046world:SetGateOpen(false)
		self\046world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, false)
	end
	local character = self:_livingCharacter()
	if character then
		self:_moveToStart(character)
	end

	self:_send()
end

function SoloRound:_request(player: Player, action: any, mode: any)
	if player ~= self\046player then
		return
	end
	local now = os\046clock()
	self\046requestTokens = math\046min(2, self\046requestTokens + (now - self\046requestAt) * 2)
	self\046requestAt = now
	if self\046requestTokens < 1 then
		return
	end
	self\046requestTokens -= 1
	if type(action) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	if action == "sync" then
		self:_send()
	elseif
		(action == "start" and self\046phase == "ready")
		or (
			action == "retry"
			and (self\046phase == "escaped" or self\046phase == "aborted" or self\046phase == "caught_out")
		)
	then
		if LightingModes\046IsValid(mode) then
			self:_startRound(mode)
		end
	elseif action == "abort" then
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
	elseif action == "menu" then
		self:_menu()
	end
end

function SoloRound:_bindCharacter(character: Model)
	if character == self\046boundCharacter then
		return
	end
	self\046boundCharacter = character
	if self\046deathConnection then
		self\046deathConnection:Disconnect()
		self\046deathConnection = nil
	end
	if
		self\046phase == "active"
		or self\046phase == "caught"
		or (self\046phase == "preparing" and self\046roundCharacter ~= nil)
	then
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
	end
	task\046spawn(function()
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
		local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
		local player = self\046player
		if not player or player\046Character ~= character or self\046boundCharacter ~= character then
			return
		end
		if not humanoid or not humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
			return
		end
		self\046deathConnection = humanoid\046Died:Connect(function()
			if self\046player and self\046player\046Character == character then
				self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
			end
		end)
		if self\046phase ~= "active" and self\046phase ~= "preparing" then
			self:_moveToStart(character)
		end
		self:_controls(self\046phase == "active" and self\046roundCharacter == character)
		self:_send()
	end)
end

function SoloRound:_addPlayer(player: Player)
	if self\046player then
		return -- One owner, no multiplayer matchmaking in this prototype\046

	self\046player = player
	self:_setRespawnLocation()
	self\046requestTokens = 2
	self\046requestAt = os\046clock()
	self\046characterConnection = player\046CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character: Model)
		self:_bindCharacter(character)
	end)
	self\046characterRemovingConnection = player\046CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character: Model)
		if
			player == self\046player
			and (character == self\046boundCharacter or character == player\046Character)
		then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
		end
	end)
	if player\046Character then
		self:_bindCharacter(player\046Character)

function SoloRound:_removePlayer(player: Player)
	if player ~= self\046player then
		return
	end
	self\046epoch += 1
	self:_clearKey()
	if self\046characterConnection then
		self\046characterConnection:Disconnect()
		self\046characterConnection = nil

	if self\046deathConnection then
		self\046deathConnection:Disconnect()
		self\046deathConnection = nil

	if self\046characterRemovingConnection then
		self\046characterRemovingConnection:Disconnect()
		self\046characterRemovingConnection = nil

	self:_restoreLighting()
	self\046lightingMode = LightingModes\046Default
	self:_stopHunt()
	self\046catches = 0
	self\046protectedUntil = 0
	self\046stamina = Stamina\046new(self\046balance\046stamina_capacity, os\046clock())
	self\046phase = "ready"
	self\046hasKey = false
	self\046gateOpen = false
	self\046diamonds = 0
	self\046reward = 0
	self\046startedAt = nil
	self\046elapsed = 0
	self\046notice = ""
	self\046roundCharacter = nil
	self\046boundCharacter = nil
	self\046controlledCharacter = nil

end

function SoloRound:_poll(now: number)
	if self\046phase ~= "active" then
		return

		return

	if
		not self\046world
		or not self\046world:IsValid()
		or not self\046world:IsOnPlayground(root\046Position)
	then
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
		return

		local caught, awakened =
			self\046hunt:Step(now - self\046huntAt, now, root, now < self\046protectedUntil)

		self\046snapshotAt = now

function SoloRound:_sprintRequest(player: Player, value: any)
	if player ~= self\046player then
		return

	local character = self:_livingCharacter()
	Stamina\046Request(
		self\046stamina,
		value,
		os\046clock(),
		self\046phase == "active" and character ~= nil and character == self\046roundCharacter
	)
end

	local character, humanoid, root = self:_livingCharacter()

	local moving = Vector3\046new(velocity\046X, 0, velocity\046Z)\046Magnitude > 0\0465
	Stamina\046Step(self\046stamina, dt, moving, active, self\046balance)

		humanoid\046WalkSpeed = if not active
			then 0
			elseif self\046stamina\046sprinting then self\046balance\046sprint_speed
			else self\046balance\046walk_speed
		humanoid:SetAttribute("corn_stamina", self\046stamina\046value)
		humanoid:SetAttribute("corn_sprinting", self\046stamina\046sprinting)
		humanoid:SetAttribute("corn_sprint_exhausted", self\046stamina\046exhausted)

function SoloRound:Start()
	self:_ensureWorld()

		end)
	)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		self:_addPlayer(player)
	end
end

function SoloRound:_send()

		else Vector3\046new(0, 0, -1)
	local horizontal = Vector3\046new(facing\046X, 0, facing\046Z)
	local startLook = if horizontal\046Magnitude > 0 then horizontal\046Unit else Vector3\046new(0, 0, -1)
	self\046snapshot:FireClient(player, {
		phase = self\046phase,
		lighting_mode = self\046lightingMode,
		minimap = self\046minimap:Snapshot(),
		has_key = self\046hasKey,
		gate_open = self\046gateOpen,
		session_diamonds = self\046diamonds,
		reward_diamonds = self\046reward,
		elapsed_sec = if self\046phase == "active" and self\046startedAt
			then os\046clock() - self\046startedAt
			else self\046elapsed,
		notice = self\046notice,
		stamina = self\046stamina\046value,
		stamina_capacity = self\046balance\046stamina_capacity,
		is_sprinting = self\046stamina\046sprinting,
		sprint_exhausted = self\046stamina\046exhausted,
		start_look = startLook,
		catches_remaining = math\046max(0, self\046balance\046max_catches - self\046catches),
		monster_state = if self\046hunt then self\046hunt\046state else "stopped",
		protection_sec = math\046max(0, self\046protectedUntil - os\046clock()),
	})
end

function SoloRound:_livingCharacter(): (Model?, Humanoid?, BasePart?)
	local player = self\046player
	local character = if player then player\046Character else nil
	if not character or not character\046Parent then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid\046Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end
	return character, humanoid, root
end

function SoloRound:_recordCharacterDeath(character: Model?)
	if
		not character
		or character ~= self\046roundCharacter
		or (self\046phase ~= "active" and self\046phase ~= "caught")
	then
		return
	end
	-- Died runs after Health reaches zero, so _livingCharacter cannot supply this root\046
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		self\046minimap:RecordDeath(character, root\046Position)
	end
end

function SoloRound:_controls(enabled: boolean)
	if not enabled then
		Stamina\046Request(self\046stamina, false, os\046clock(), false)
	end
	local character, humanoid = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not character or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	if self\046controlledCharacter ~= character then
		self\046controlledCharacter = character
		self\046jumpPower = humanoid\046JumpPower
		self\046jumpHeight = humanoid\046JumpHeight
		self\046autoRotate = humanoid\046AutoRotate
	end
	humanoid\046WalkSpeed = if enabled then self\046balance\046walk_speed else 0
	humanoid\046JumpPower = if enabled then self\046jumpPower else 0
	humanoid\046JumpHeight = if enabled then self\046jumpHeight else 0
	humanoid\046AutoRotate = enabled and self\046autoRotate
end

function SoloRound:_fallbackSpawn(): BasePart?
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
	then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(AuthoredWorld\046FindSafeSpawn, map)
	if not ok then
		self\046context\046Log:Warn("Cannot find a safe CornMap spawn:", result)
		return nil
	end
	return result
end

function SoloRound:_setRespawnLocation()
	local player = self\046player
	if not player then
		return
	end
	local spawn = self\046selectedSpawn
	player\046RespawnLocation = if spawn
			and spawn:IsA("SpawnLocation")
			and spawn:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)
		then spawn
		else nil
end

function SoloRound:_chooseSpawn()
	if self\046world and self\046world:IsValid() then
		self\046selectedSpawn = self\046world:SelectSpawn(self\046random:NextInteger(1, #self\046world\046Spawns))
	else
		self\046selectedSpawn = self:_fallbackSpawn()
	end
	self:_setRespawnLocation()
end

function SoloRound:_moveToStart(character: Model)
	local spawn = self\046selectedSpawn
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not spawn
		or not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or not AuthoredWorld\046IsSafeSpawn(map, spawn)
	then
		spawn = self:_fallbackSpawn()
		self\046selectedSpawn = spawn
	end
	if not spawn then
		self\046context\046Log:Warn("No valid CornMap start; install or repair CornerSpawns")
		return
	end
	self:_setRespawnLocation()
	character:PivotTo(AuthoredWorld\046SpawnCFrame(spawn))
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		root\046AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3\046zero
		root\046AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3\046zero
	end
end

function SoloRound:_clearKey()
	if self\046keyConnection then
		self\046keyConnection:Disconnect()
		self\046keyConnection = nil
	end
	if self\046world then
		self\046world:ClearKey()
	end
end

function SoloRound:_finish(phase: string, notice: string)
	if self\046phase ~= "active" and self\046phase ~= "preparing" and self\046phase ~= "caught" then
		return
	end
	-- Fix the terminal state before rewarding or notifying any client\046
	self\046elapsed = if self\046startedAt then os\046clock() - self\046startedAt else 0
	self\046phase = phase
	self\046epoch += 1
	self\046notice = notice
	self\046reward = if phase == "escaped" then self\046balance\046escape_reward_diamonds else 0
	self\046diamonds += self\046reward
	self\046hasKey = false
	self:_clearKey()
	if self\046world then
		self\046world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, self\046gateOpen)
	end
	self:_stopHunt()
	self:_controls(false)
	self:_send()
	self\046context\046Log:Info("Round finished:", phase, "reward:", self\046reward)
end

function SoloRound:_canInteract(
	player: Player,
	item: BasePart,
	itemPrompt: ProximityPrompt
): boolean
	if player ~= self\046player or self\046phase ~= "active" or not itemPrompt\046Enabled then
		return false
	end
	local now = os\046clock()
	if now - self\046interactionAt < 0\04625 then
		return false
	end
	self\046interactionAt = now
	local character, _, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not character or character ~= self\046roundCharacter or not root then
		return false
	end
	if not self\046world or not item:IsDescendantOf(self\046world\046Root) then
		return false
	end
	local direction = item\046Position - root\046Position
	if direction\046Magnitude > self\046balance\046interaction_radius then
		return false
	end
	local params = RaycastParams\046new()
	params\046FilterType = Enum\046RaycastFilterType\046Exclude
	params\046FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params\046RespectCanCollide = true
	local hit = Workspace:Raycast(root\046Position, direction, params)
	return not hit or hit\046Instance == item
end

function SoloRound:_openGate(player: Player)
	local world = self\046world
	if
		not world
		or self\046gateOpen
		or not self:_canInteract(player, world\046GateAnchor, world\046GatePrompt)
	then
		return
	end
	local _, _, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not root or not world:IsGateFront(root\046Position) then
		return
	end
	if not self\046hasKey then
		self\046notice = "corn_loop_need_key"
		self:_send()
		return
	end
	self\046hasKey = false
	self\046gateOpen = true
	self\046notice = ""
	world:SetGateOpen(true)
	self:_send()
end

function SoloRound:_ensureWorld(): boolean
	if self\046world then
		return self\046world:IsValid()
	end
	local ok, result =
		pcall(AuthoredWorld\046new, self\046balance\046interaction_radius, self\046balance\046key_slot_count)
	if not ok then
		self\046context\046Log:Warn("Cannot bind editable CornMap:", result)
		return false
	end
	self\046world = result
	if self\046selectedSpawn and table\046find(self\046world\046Spawns, self\046selectedSpawn) then
		self\046world\046Spawn = self\046selectedSpawn
	end
	table\046insert(
		self\046connections,
		self\046world\046GatePrompt\046Triggered:Connect(function(player: Player)
			self:_openGate(player)
		end)
	)
	return true
end

function SoloRound:_stopHunt()
	if self\046hunt then
		self\046hunt:Destroy()
		self\046hunt = nil
	end
end

function SoloRound:_bindKey(keyPrompt: ProximityPrompt)
	if self\046keyConnection then
		self\046keyConnection:Disconnect()
	end
	local epoch = self\046epoch
	self\046keyConnection = keyPrompt\046Triggered:Connect(function(player: Player)
		local key = self\046world\046Key
		if
			self\046epoch ~= epoch
			or self\046hasKey
			or self\046gateOpen
			or not key
			or keyPrompt ~= self\046world\046KeyPrompt
		then
			return
		end
		if not self:_canInteract(player, key, keyPrompt) then
			return
		end
		self\046hasKey = true
		self\046notice = ""
		self:_clearKey()
		self:_send()
	end)
end

function SoloRound:_caught(root: BasePart)
	if self\046phase ~= "active" then
		return
	end
	self\046minimap:RecordCaught(root\046Position)
	self\046catches += 1
	if self\046catches >= self\046balance\046max_catches then
		self:_finish("caught_out", "corn_hunt_defeat_notice")
		return
	end
	self\046elapsed = if self\046startedAt then os\046clock() - self\046startedAt else 0
	self\046phase = "caught"
	self\046notice = if self\046hasKey then "corn_hunt_key_dropped" else "corn_hunt_first_catch"
	local epoch = self\046epoch
	if self\046hasKey then
		self\046hasKey = false
		local prompt = self\046world:DropKey(root\046Position, self\046balance\046key_drop_adjust_radius)
		if not prompt then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_hunt_drop_error")
			return
		end
		self:_bindKey(prompt)
	end
	self\046world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, self\046gateOpen)
	self:_controls(false)
	self:_send()
	task\046delay(self\046balance\046capture_transition_sec, function()
		if self\046epoch ~= epoch or self\046phase ~= "caught" then
			return
		end
		local character = self:_livingCharacter()
		if not character or character ~= self\046roundCharacter then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
			return
		end
		self:_moveToStart(character)
		self\046stamina = Stamina\046new(self\046balance\046stamina_capacity, os\046clock())
		self\046protectedUntil = os\046clock() + self\046balance\046respawn_protection_sec
		self\046hunt:ResetHome()
		self\046huntAt = os\046clock()
		self\046phase = "active"
		self\046world:SetInteractionEnabled(true, self\046gateOpen)
		self:_controls(true)
		self:_send()
	end)
end

function SoloRound:_restoreLighting()
	if self\046lightingState then
		LightingModes\046Restore(Lighting, self\046lightingState)
		self\046lightingState = nil
	end
end

function SoloRound:_startRound(mode: string)
	if
		self\046phase ~= "ready"
		and self\046phase ~= "escaped"
		and self\046phase ~= "aborted"
		and self\046phase ~= "caught_out"
	then
		return
	end
	if not LightingModes\046IsValid(mode) then
		return
	end
	self\046minimap:ResetHistory()
	self\046lightingMode = mode
	if not self\046lightingState then
		self\046lightingState = LightingModes\046Capture(Lighting)
	end
	LightingModes\046Apply(Lighting, mode)
	self\046epoch += 1
	self\046stamina = Stamina\046new(self\046balance\046stamina_capacity, os\046clock())
	self:_stopHunt()
	self\046catches = 0
	self\046protectedUntil = 0
	local epoch = self\046epoch
	self\046phase = "preparing"
	self\046startedAt = nil
	self\046elapsed = 0
	self\046reward = 0
	self\046notice = ""
	self\046hasKey = false
	self\046gateOpen = false
	self\046roundCharacter = nil
	self:_clearKey()
	self:_controls(false)
	self:_send()
	if not self:_ensureWorld() then
		self:_chooseSpawn()
		local character = self:_livingCharacter()
		if character then
			self:_moveToStart(character)
		end
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
		return
	end
	self:_chooseSpawn()
	self\046world:SetGateOpen(false)
	self\046world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, false)

	task\046spawn(function()
		local deadline = os\046clock() + 10
		local character: Model? = nil
		while
			self\046epoch == epoch
			and self\046phase == "preparing"
			and self\046player
			and self\046player\046Parent == Players
		do
			character = self:_livingCharacter()
			if character or os\046clock() >= deadline then
				break
			end
			task\046wait(0\0461)
		end
		if self\046epoch ~= epoch or self\046phase ~= "preparing" then
			return
		end
		if not character then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
			return
		end
		if not self\046world or not self\046world:IsValid() then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
			return
		end
		self:_moveToStart(character)
		self\046roundCharacter = character
		local slot = self\046world\046Slots[self\046random:NextInteger(1, #self\046world\046Slots)]
		local keyPrompt = self\046world:SpawnKey(slot)
		self:_bindKey(keyPrompt)
		self\046startedAt = os\046clock()
		local ok, hunt = pcall(MonsterHunt\046new, self\046world, self\046balance, self\046startedAt)
		if not ok then
			self\046context\046Log:Warn("Cannot start hunt:", hunt)
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
			return
		end
		self\046hunt = hunt
		self\046huntAt = self\046startedAt
		self\046phase = "active"
		self\046world:SetInteractionEnabled(true, false)
		self:_controls(true)
		self:_send()
		self\046context\046Log:Info("Solo round started")
	end)
end

function SoloRound:_menu()
	if self\046phase ~= "escaped" and self\046phase ~= "aborted" and self\046phase ~= "caught_out" then
		return
	end
	self\046epoch += 1
	self\046phase = "ready"
	self:_restoreLighting()
	self\046reward = 0
	self\046elapsed = 0
	self\046startedAt = nil
	self\046notice = ""
	self\046hasKey = false
	self\046gateOpen = false
	self:_clearKey()
	if self\046world then
		self\046world:SetGateOpen(false)
		self\046world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, false)
	end
	local character = self:_livingCharacter()
	if character then
		self:_moveToStart(character)
	end
	self:_controls(false)
	self:_send()
end

function SoloRound:_request(player: Player, action: any, mode: any)
	if player ~= self\046player then
		return
	end
	local now = os\046clock()
	self\046requestTokens = math\046min(2, self\046requestTokens + (now - self\046requestAt) * 2)
	self\046requestAt = now
	if self\046requestTokens < 1 then
		return
	end
	self\046requestTokens -= 1
	if type(action) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	if action == "sync" then
		self:_send()
	elseif
		(action == "start" and self\046phase == "ready")
		or (
			action == "retry"
			and (self\046phase == "escaped" or self\046phase == "aborted" or self\046phase == "caught_out")
		)
	then
		if LightingModes\046IsValid(mode) then
			self:_startRound(mode)
		end
	elseif action == "abort" then
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
	elseif action == "menu" then
		self:_menu()
	end
end

function SoloRound:_bindCharacter(character: Model)
	if character == self\046boundCharacter then
		return
	end
	self\046boundCharacter = character
	if self\046deathConnection then
		self\046deathConnection:Disconnect()
		self\046deathConnection = nil
	end
	if
		self\046phase == "active"
		or self\046phase == "caught"
		or (self\046phase == "preparing" and self\046roundCharacter ~= nil)
	then
		self:_recordCharacterDeath(self\046roundCharacter)
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
	end
	task\046spawn(function()
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
		local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
		local player = self\046player
		if not player or player\046Character ~= character or self\046boundCharacter ~= character then
			return
		end
		if not humanoid or not humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
			return
		end
		self\046deathConnection = humanoid\046Died:Connect(function()
			if self\046player and self\046player\046Character == character then
				self:_recordCharacterDeath(character)
				self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
			end
		end)
		if self\046phase ~= "active" and self\046phase ~= "preparing" then
			self:_moveToStart(character)
		end
		self:_controls(self\046phase == "active" and self\046roundCharacter == character)
		self:_send()
	end)
end

function SoloRound:_addPlayer(player: Player)
	if self\046player then
		return -- One owner, no multiplayer matchmaking in this prototype\046
	end
	self\046player = player
	self:_setRespawnLocation()
	self\046requestTokens = 2
	self\046requestAt = os\046clock()
	self\046characterConnection = player\046CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character: Model)
		self:_bindCharacter(character)
	end)
	self\046characterRemovingConnection = player\046CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character: Model)
		if
			player == self\046player
			and (character == self\046boundCharacter or character == player\046Character)
		then
			self:_recordCharacterDeath(character)
			self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
		end
	end)
	if player\046Character then
		self:_bindCharacter(player\046Character)
	end
	self:_send()
end

function SoloRound:_removePlayer(player: Player)
	if player ~= self\046player then
		return
	end
	self\046epoch += 1
	self:_clearKey()
	if self\046characterConnection then
		self\046characterConnection:Disconnect()
		self\046characterConnection = nil
	end
	if self\046deathConnection then
		self\046deathConnection:Disconnect()
		self\046deathConnection = nil
	end
	if self\046characterRemovingConnection then
		self\046characterRemovingConnection:Disconnect()
		self\046characterRemovingConnection = nil
	end
	self\046player = nil
	self\046minimap:ClearHistory()
	self:_restoreLighting()
	self\046lightingMode = LightingModes\046Default
	self:_stopHunt()
	self\046catches = 0
	self\046protectedUntil = 0
	self\046stamina = Stamina\046new(self\046balance\046stamina_capacity, os\046clock())
	self\046phase = "ready"
	self\046hasKey = false
	self\046gateOpen = false
	self\046diamonds = 0
	self\046reward = 0
	self\046startedAt = nil
	self\046elapsed = 0
	self\046notice = ""
	self\046roundCharacter = nil
	self\046boundCharacter = nil
	self\046controlledCharacter = nil
	if self\046world then
		self\046world:SetGateOpen(false)
		self\046world:SetInteractionEnabled(false, false)
	end
end

function SoloRound:_poll(now: number)
	if self\046phase ~= "active" then
		return
	end
	local character, _, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not character or character ~= self\046roundCharacter or not root then
		local roundCharacter = self\046roundCharacter
		local humanoid = if roundCharacter
			then roundCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			else nil
		if humanoid and humanoid\046Health <= 0 then
			self:_recordCharacterDeath(roundCharacter)
		end
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_result_aborted")
		return
	end
	if
		not self\046world
		or not self\046world:IsValid()
		or not self\046world:IsOnPlayground(root\046Position)
	then
		self:_finish("aborted", "corn_loop_setup_error")
		return
	end
	-- A visit and capture in the same tick both belong to this pre-teleport position\046
	self\046minimap:Poll(self\046world, root\046Position)
	if self\046hunt then
		local caught, awakened =
			self\046hunt:Step(now - self\046huntAt, now, root, now < self\046protectedUntil)
		self\046huntAt = now
		if awakened then
			self\046notice = "corn_hunt_awakened"
		end
		if caught then
			self:_caught(root)
			return
		end
	end
	if self\046gateOpen and self\046world:IsInExit(root\046Position) then
		self:_finish("escaped", "")
		return
	end
	if now - self\046snapshotAt >= 0\04625 then
		self\046snapshotAt = now
		self:_send()
	end
end

function SoloRound:_sprintRequest(player: Player, value: any)
	if player ~= self\046player then
		return
	end
	local character = self:_livingCharacter()
	Stamina\046Request(
		self\046stamina,
		value,
		os\046clock(),
		self\046phase == "active" and character ~= nil and character == self\046roundCharacter
	)
end

function SoloRound:_movement(dt: number)
	local character, humanoid, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	local active = self\046phase == "active" and character ~= nil and character == self\046roundCharacter
	local velocity = if root then root\046AssemblyLinearVelocity else Vector3\046zero
	local moving = Vector3\046new(velocity\046X, 0, velocity\046Z)\046Magnitude > 0\0465
	Stamina\046Step(self\046stamina, dt, moving, active, self\046balance)
	if humanoid then
		humanoid\046WalkSpeed = if not active
			then 0
			elseif self\046stamina\046sprinting then self\046balance\046sprint_speed
			else self\046balance\046walk_speed
		humanoid:SetAttribute("corn_stamina", self\046stamina\046value)
		humanoid:SetAttribute("corn_sprinting", self\046stamina\046sprinting)
		humanoid:SetAttribute("corn_sprint_exhausted", self\046stamina\046exhausted)
	end
end

function SoloRound:Start()
	self:_ensureWorld()
	self:_chooseSpawn()
	table\046insert(
		self\046connections,
		self\046sprintIntent\046OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, value: any)
			self:_sprintRequest(player, value)
		end)
	)
	table\046insert(
		self\046connections,
		self\046action\046OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, action: any, mode: any)
			self:_request(player, action, mode)
		end)
	)
	table\046insert(
		self\046connections,
		Players\046PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
			self:_addPlayer(player)
		end)
	)
	table\046insert(
		self\046connections,
		Players\046PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
			self:_removePlayer(player)
		end)
	)
	table\046insert(
		self\046connections,
		RunService\046Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
			self:_movement(dt)
			local now = os\046clock()
			if now - self\046pollAt >= MinimapState\046PollInterval then
				self\046pollAt = now
				self:_poll(now)
			end
		end)
	)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		self:_addPlayer(player)
